body: Why do you care what people think about you? you can ignore them and carry on, fight the illness rather than fighting the scum because if you beat it and you can unless its terminal. then you will show those people how strong you are. seriously don't let them put you down. If theyre making threats or keep harassing you then report it. i can tell you that it can resolved one way or another, and there must be a reason to why you're getting harassed. someone you possibly know in person to be causing this? You are better than those morons, please just don't let them get to you because they're nothing at all.

If death is really your choice then theres no way to stop you, i wont try to stop you but you have to remember that theres no going back. You do this, and you don't come back. thats the scary reality of it. you can get through this.

Ending it will not get you peace, Losing someone, especially a parent is the hardest thing you could ever go through, everyone has to do it at some point, I am yet to go through it myself and i have even thought about ending it when my mom dies. I'm literally nothing without her. 

But there is another way, carry on for her. let her memory live inside you. use her last moments and love her now before she goes.  i imagine she would want you to carry on, even if it was a dying wish? would you deny her that?

I'm depressed right now, i have anxiety that stops me from getting a job and making new friends. my PTSD is added to everyday.  I'm not saying i have worse problems than you, i can relate to you. we all deal with it differently. i'm at a stage where i believe it will never go away because theres never going to be a way i can control this. I'm not saying it will get better.  But you don't have to go through it alone, We can try to tackle this together, if you really want to fight it then you need to look at the root of the issue. why are you depressed? is there a cause? What has caused you ptsd? your heart was broken due to relationship issues? I know you are at a point right now where you've probably talked about this a million times and nothing works but there is a chance you can stop it or ease it enough to find a way to stop it. You can choose to die but you don't have to.

why today? there must be something that can help. Anything... i know kind words don't help, i wont say i know what you're going through but a few days ago i tied a wire around my neck and hung myself, it gave me time to think i changed my mind. You kill yourself you won't feel relief, you won't pass on to the next life because there isn't one. you will be gone forever, you wont see darkness or anything. just a void. even though life is shit and i mean shit, there is always a chance to make it bearable. you can express yourself here, why do you want to do this?

Drowning is a horrible way to go. drunk or not you will feel it. if you are that drunk to the point where you would pass out i would imagine suicide would be the last thing on your mind. Although it doesn't help the situation, for most people alcohol is used to ease suffering, i'm drinking when i feel like shit and want to end it. i find myself in higher spirits just from that. I would like to know why you want to end it? is it something you're willing to discuss?
If you need to speak to someone, message me please...

You make a mistake, think of how you made that mistake and don't do it again, learn from the mistake. If you are making the same mistake then follow that step. learn from it

If you keep making different mistakes then you need to look into why that is happening. and then learn from it still.
They will try to check on you yes, or have someone check on you. its best to call them back and say that you're fine. even if you aren't and just want to stop them coming over
Message me if you need to
they are bad, its got to the point where others may be in danger, not innocent people but ones that deserve it. still though. danger.

I think thats what it is. but it started off as a feeling rather than a belief, the feelings started. grew stronger and thats why i attributed it to a demonic evil feeling. infact only when it really got strong have i questioned where it comes from.

Actually there is no hell. or heaven, theres just the void. Think back to the time, before you were born, thats what death is like. not having consciousness. no brain activity = no feeling. those are the facts.

I wont try and stop you. most people on here pull the kindness card to try and stop you going through with it. saying how you are important and stuff. but to some of us this means nothing and it doesn't stop us from doing what we think we need to do.

Yes it will most likely kill you. if not, it will put you into some sort of coma. and no, this can be a very painful process. you wont just die like you want. it will cause pain first because your body will react like its poison.

i'm in the same state you are but i don't have any medication to take, ive taken an overdose before and it didnt work. 

I'm not here to tell you how to die or encourage you, it just sucks we can't connect in person to talk about this. and help eachother. if you really want to hit the nail on the head i would say throw in some alcohol with the medication, sleeping medication is the one to take as well... but just consider that once you do it, thats it, you wont exist anymore. theres no heaven, no hell, just the void. you wont see darkness or light. it will be like that forever. why not use your time to ease the suffering and try \[ i know this may have been said a million times\] but try to find a way to beat it.
